source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), ranged attacks can target an **Engaged** enemy **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, but not with **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapons. Such attacks take −1 to the **Hit roll**, unless made with a **[[CLOSE-QUARTERS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/close-quarters)** weapon by a unit Engaged with that target.

In the example, the **VEHICLE** is Engaged with **INFANTRY** unit B:

- **Unengaged** **INFANTRY** unit A shoots the **VEHICLE** with [normal shooting](vsdata:core-rule/normal-shooting) at −1.
- B can shoot back at the **VEHICLE** using only its **[[CLOSE-QUARTERS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/close-quarters)** weapons.
- The **VEHICLE** uses **[Close-Quarters Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting)** against both **INFANTRY** units; it cannot aim **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** at B, but can at other unengaged units.

targetBasedHitModifier.recipient: each attacking model making a qualifying ranged attack

example.blastVsEngagedVehicle: prohibited; may aim at other unengaged units
